title: Choose Qumaa's new visual world
question: The roll assigned The Ruled Page. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: The Ruled Page
options.lineage: the ruled Arabic manuscript page: a framed text block with commentary in the margin
options.thesis: Evidence sits in the margin beside the claim it supports, the way a gloss sits beside the text; the candidate table becomes a ruled page and the score never stands alone.
options.viewport: A deep indigo-ink header carries the lockup and the five tabs in both themes. Below, a contents column of saved jobs and the job workspace: the candidate table set as a ruled text block, with a gloss margin on the end side holding each row's best passage; required criteria rubricated in red; the selected row illuminated in brass; dark leads, light is paper.
options.risk: Fine rules on indigo can drift toward heritage-luxury if they thicken; the gloss margin must carry real passages and earn its width on a laptop screen.

raised.raise: Proof pairing: no match number appears without its passage beside it, in the table, the scorecard and the compare grid.
Registered comparison: every candidate keeps identical column registration and scale, so differences read down the page at a glance.
Nothing labelled twice: the eyebrow, title and hint stacks collapse to one statement and one figure owns each field.
State by desaturation: candidates marked not proceeding print in grayscale instead of disappearing.
Weight as hierarchy: a fixed four-step weight ladder on the bundled Plex Sans Variable carries rank; no ad-hoc sizes.

options.label: Wayfinding
options.lineage: Riyadh Metro and KAFD bilingual wayfinding
options.thesis: Jobs, stages and statuses carry numbered line badges in line colours; the pipeline is a line of stops and the candidate table reads like a station board.
options.viewport: A graphite shell with white type; the saved-jobs column shows each job with a line badge; the candidate table is a station board with status badges and arrow strips; the pipeline tab is a horizontal line with stops.
options.risk: Familiar: colour-coded status chips and a stage track are what most recruiting products already ship, and six line colours become a rainbow without discipline.

options.label: The Timetable
options.lineage: a 1971 pocket airline timetable read as a rack of tinted slides
options.thesis: One type size everywhere; rank is carried by weight, case, reversal and rule, and every state is a mark in a fixed cell.
options.viewport: Paper ground, flat containers (the rake is dropped as costume); the scorecard and the compare grid are timetable cells with filled, hollow, vermilion-strike and green-confirm marks; headings differ from body only by weight and case.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for scorecards and the compare grid; loses on audience identification, since a 1971 acetate rack is nobody's Gulf memory.
options.risk: A single size makes long Arabic labels and section titles depend on weight alone.

options.label: Monochrome product marketing
options.lineage: near-black on near-white software marketing with one accent
options.case: A grey screen with one accent is the category default this redesign exists to leave; identification with a Gulf recruiter is nil.
options.kept: Every claim paired with the detail that proves it.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.lineage: one plant through five seasons on cream plates
options.case: Cream engraving reads as a museum, not a recruiting desk, and the user rejected warm-cream template looks.
options.kept: Fixed scale and shared baseline make change comparable.

options.label: Factory catalog sleeve
options.lineage: matte black sleeve, white pulse plot, colour-coded title strip
options.case: Replacing names with codes is the opposite of clarity for a recruiter who lives by names.
options.kept: Nothing is labelled twice; one figure owns the field.

options.label: Character goods catalog
options.lineage: ranked pastel roster of rounded mascots
options.case: Consumer-app softness, explicitly rejected; a roster of mascots has nothing to say about CV evidence.
options.kept: Retired entries print in grayscale rather than vanishing.

options.label: Variable font specimen
options.lineage: an interactive type specimen with live axis sliders
options.case: A type foundry's demonstration surface; the audience does not identify with it and the giant glyph has no job here.
options.kept: A single weight axis as the hierarchy instrument, one token no component overrides.

canonCard.label: The ATS standard
canonCard.thesis: What applicant-tracking products ship, executed impeccably: sidebar, cards, kanban.
canonCard.viewport: A grey left sidebar with icons, white cards on a light grey ground, a kanban pipeline, violet primary buttons, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design, and the look you said would feel wrong.
